acquirer.name: BlackRock Muni Intermediate Duration Fund, Inc. (renamed BlackRock Municipal Income Fund, Inc.)

listed_quote.quote: BlackRock MuniHoldings Investment Quality Fund (NYSE: MFL) and BlackRock Muni Intermediate Duration Fund, Inc. (to be renamed “BlackRock Municipal Income Fund, Inc.” effective October 1, 2021) (NYSE: MUI)

announcement.quote: have approved the reorganization of MFL with and into MUI, with MUI continuing as the surviving Fund (the “Reorganization”).

outcome_evidence.quote: BlackRock Announces Closing of Reorganization of Two Municipal Closed-End Funds

deals.notes: On 2022-02-04 MUI shareholders approved but MFL common shareholders did not reach the requisite vote and the meeting was adjourned to 2022-03-04; the 2022-03-04 release says the requisite vote of MFL shareholders approved. The 2022-04-11 release excerpt is cut off mid-sentence ('is effective as of the opening for').
